    Rajasthan Oxytocin Quality Investigation

    PRODUCT
    TOCIN · Oxytocin injection (5 ml and 1 ml reported)Oxytocin
    LOCATION
    Kota, Rajasthan, India
    EVENT DATE
    May 2026 (reported)
    PUBLISHED
    25 May 2026 – 6 Jul 2026
    MANUFACTURER
    Jackson Laboratories Pvt LtdCORROBORATED
    DISTRIBUTOR
    M/s Rajasthan Medical HallSINGLE REPORT
    BATCH
    No batch or lot numbers are published in the sources read. Reports describe a 5 ml batch and a different 1 ml batch.
    WHY IT MATTERS

    A product failed testing and regulators acted on its supply chain, yet the reports describe more than one batch and no proven link to the deaths. Separating what is verified from what is assumed is the whole investigation.
